hooks.command: V="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/scripts/gates/hooks_manifest.sh; if [ -x "$V" ]; then "$V" --check "$HOME"/.modernize/psa/tools/hooks/current; else echo "【钩子告警】核对不了已装钩子（$V 缺失或不可执行）"; fi; H="$HOME"/.modernize/psa/tools/hooks/current/scripts/hooks/git_ceiling_env.sh; [ -x "$H" ] && "$H" && exit 0; echo "【钩子告警】git_ceiling_env.sh 缺失或出错（${H}），本会话没有 GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES 保护，cd 出工作区后别跑 git；请 one-ops 执行 scripts/gates/install.sh"; exit 0

H="$HOME"/.modernize/psa/tools/one-session/start_sheet/start_sheet.py; [ -f "$H" ] && /usr/bin/python3 -I "$H" --hook && exit 0; echo "【钩子告警】工具库开工单 start_sheet.py 缺失或出错（${H}），没有开工单；手动读 docs/modernization/sessions/<会话名>.md 并向调度要卡；请 one-ops 修工具库 ~/.modernize/psa/tools/one-session/start_sheet（start_sheet.py --self-test）"; exit 0

H="$HOME"/.modernize/psa/tools/hooks/current/scripts/gates/pre_tool_dispatch.py; I=$(cat); if [ -x "$H" ]; then printf %s "$I" | "$H"; c=$?; why="异常退出（退出码 ${c}：门导入失败、出错、超时或崩溃）"; else c=127; why="入口缺失或不可执行（${H}）"; fi; [ "$c" = 0 ] || [ "$c" = 2 ] && exit "$c"; L="$HOME"/.modernize/psa/tools/hooks/gate_failures.log; if printf %s "$I" | /usr/bin/python3 -I -c 'import json,sys
p=json.load(sys.stdin)
if p.get("tool_name","Bash") not in ["Bash", "Monitor", "mcp__terminal__run_in_terminal", "mcp__Claude_Browser__preview_start"]:sys.exit(0)
if p.get("tool_name")=="Monitor" and "command" not in p.get("tool_input",{}):sys.exit(0)
c=p["tool_input"]["command"].lower().translate({92:None,34:None,39:None})
far="aliyun bcp curl http isql mariadb mongo mssql-cli mysql mysqldump osql pg_dump pg_dumpall pg_restore psql redis-cli rsync scp sftp sqlcmd sqlpackage ssh tsql usql wget xhs /dev/tcp /dev/udp".split()
sys.exit(1 if any(t in c for t in far) else 0)'; then echo "【钩子告警】生产写门${why}；保守预筛判定这条命令不涉及生产，放行；请 one-ops 执行 scripts/gates/install.sh 修复" >&2; printf "%s\t放行\t%s\n" "$(date +%FT%T)" "$why" 2>/dev/null >>"$L"; exit 0; fi; echo "生产写门${why}；保守预筛不能排除这条命令涉及生产，按拒绝处理；请把报错转 one-ops" >&2; printf "%s\t拒绝\t%s\n" "$(date +%FT%T)" "$why" 2>/dev/null >>"$L"; exit 2

H="$HOME"/.modernize/psa/tools/one-session/node_ready/node_ready.py; if [ -f "$H" ]; then env -u HANDOFF_STATE /usr/bin/python3 -I "$H" --gate; c=$?; else c=127; fi; [ "$c" = 0 ] && exit 0; [ "$c" = 2 ] || echo "clear_session 门异常退出（退出码 ${c}：工具库 node_ready.py 缺失、出错或超时，${H}），按拒绝处理；请 one-ops 修工具库 ~/.modernize/psa/tools/one-session/node_ready（node_ready.py --self-test）" >&2; exit 2
